From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Subject: Competitive bake-off recap & next steps — OmniHealth

Hi Joe / Karen —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned heading into the bake-off week.

TL;DR
- Top pain points: slow triage of patient notes (high latency), rising inference costs at scale, and the need for on-prem option for PHI workflows.
- Goal: baseline vendor latency and cost at your typical 8k tokens/session workload, validate output fidelity on representative prompts, and confirm integration path with your inference gateway.

What we heard (pain & priority)
- Latency requirement: p95 < 250ms for generation-only flows (current target).
- Cost sensitivity: must reduce per-token spend by >=30% vs current provider to be considered.
- Security: deployment options (VPC/private) + SOC2 evidence required.

High-level vendor comparison (from today's tech call)
- Redwood (us): GPU-optimized serving, KV/prefix caching, configurable quantization + private/VPC deployments. Strong observability (per-route latency/cost).
- Competitor A: good latency in short sequences but limited caching for session continuity.
- Competitor B: cheaper inference but no private deployment path and slower support turnaround.

Open questions for OmniHealth (please confirm):
1) Are the 8k-token sessions representative, or should we use a 4k/16k split for test vectors?
2) Who will run the integration POC on your side (security/infra contact)?
3) Any non-negotiable compliance evidence beyond SOC2 and encrypt-at-rest?

Proposed bake-off plan (attached test plan + summary):
- Day 0: Exchange test dataset and security questionnaire.
- Day 1: Redwood runs standard latency & cost run on a reserved pod using your 8k sessions.
- Day 2: Quality eval on sample prompts (n=200) and joint triage session.
- Day 3: Integration smoke test (gateway + auth) + result review.

Next steps / asks from OmniHealth
- Confirm test dataset (8k tokens) or provide adjusted split by EOD Wed 9/16.
- Please introduce the infra/security contact so we can share the private deployment checklist.
- Availability window for joint tests: Thu 9/17 or Fri 9/18 — what works best?

Attachments: redwood_vs_competitors_summary.pdf (vendor summary) and bakeoff-test-plan.xlsx (detailed test steps).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15-min call to align if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
